gherkin.scenario: Add a new leave type with allowance
given: I am logged in as an administrator
when: I go to the Leave Types section
I fill in the name field with "test"
I fill in the limit field with "5"
then: The page should display "Changes to leave types were saved"
The leave type "test" should be visible in the leave types list and have Color 3 and a limit of 5

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The page should display "Changes to leave types were saved"
The leave type "test" should be visible in the leave types list and have Color 3 and a limit of 5
